Proprietary statement ending net position 18,491,755 (p12; Internal Service Fund 82,454; change 998,792) vs Statement of Net Position 18,491,754 (pp2, 10; Internal Service Fund 82,453) and Statement of Activities change 998,791 (p4)

notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (Total Governmental Funds column, pp7-8); roll-forward on fund balance (beginning 2,672,560 and ending 1,982,213 as printed on p8; no restatement printed). Debt proceeds 1,648,836 and debt issuance costs (16,488) are under Other Financing Sources (p8). Transfers out 8,523 go to the fiduciary fund (Statement of Activities 'Transfers - fiduciary fund', p4); the enterprise fund's transfers in 77,352 likewise. No single governmental cash total is printed (cash, county treasurer, certificates of deposit and restricted cash lines are separate), so beginning/ending cash are null. Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund (Total Proprietary Funds column, p11; enterprise + internal service); beginning 17,492,963 and ending 18,491,755 as printed on p12 (no restatement printed); totals computed from operating + nonoperating lines because no single total is printed. Proprietary cash flows from the Schedule of Cash Flows - Proprietary Fund (p17, Enterprise Fund column); its beginning/ending cash lines are on a page not in the trim. Detail: General, Debt Service, Special Grants and Reuse fund columns of the governmental funds statement; Street Repair and Maintenance Fund from its own schedule (p14, ties to its column); business-type detail from the proprietary statement's Enterprise Fund and Internal Service Fund columns (p11, same modified cash basis as the statement lines). Not recorded: the All-Purpose Fund budgetary schedule (p13, one combined column for all funds incl. utilities, budgetary basis) and the Enterprise Fund Accounts accrual-basis combining schedules by department (pp15-16; accrual basis, different from the modified cash statements: e.g. beginning net position 18,064,291 vs 17,411,563). Read pages 1-17 of 17.
